findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Turkish side labels instead of the established karşı kenar and komşu kenar terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used karşı kenar and komşu kenar while the formulas displayed only karşı and komşu.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Turkish side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Turkish side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The formulas displayed karşı and komşu while the section defined the terms as karşı kenar and komşu kenar.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established Turkish side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Turkish explanation.
evidence: The example labels were karşı and komşu while the explanatory text used karşı kenar and komşu kenar.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to karşı kenar and komşu kenar.
